# ==============================================================================
# T1-A: POST-WAR OVERSEAS CONQUEST HANDOVER (oe_col4.1)
# ==============================================================================
oe_col4.1 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	title = oe_col4.1.t
	desc = oe_col4.1.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v185_grand_peace_treaty_harbor.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		exists = scope:oe_col4_region
		exists = scope:target_colony
	}

	# Option A: Hand over all newly conquered non-core lands in this region to target_colony
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.1.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.1.a.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 85 }
		oe_col4_transfer_region_to_colony = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target_colony }
			scope:target_colony = {
				oe_col4_apply_unified_colonial_name = yes
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_col4_viceroy_grant_mod
					years = 5
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Option B: Keep coastal ports as Crown maritime stations, transfer inland territories
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.1.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.1.b.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
		oe_col4_transfer_inland_to_colony = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target_colony }
			scope:target_colony = {
				oe_col4_apply_unified_colonial_name = yes
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_crown_enclave_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
	}

	# Option C: Retain direct Crown administration over all conquered holdings
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.1.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.1.c.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 5 }
		add_prestige = 3
	}
}

oe_col4.11 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = negative
	title = oe_col4.11.t
	desc = oe_col4.11.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v180_columbian_harvest_plague.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations >= 2
		any_owned_location = {
			is_capital = no
			population < 2.5
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				is_capital = no
				population < 2.5
			}
			save_scope_as = depop_loc
		}
	}

	# Abandon stricken frontier settlement to regroup survivors
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.11.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.11.a.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 85 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:depop_loc }
			abandon_location = scope:depop_loc
		}
		add_stability = 2
	}

	# Spend treasury & stability to hold the frontier settlement
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.11.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.11.b.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 15 }
		add_stability = -4
		add_gold = -25
	}
}

# T3: GLOBAL COLUMBIAN EXCHANGE 2.0 — CROPS & LIVESTOCK (oe_col4.30-31)
# ==============================================================================
oe_col4.30 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	title = oe_col4.30.t
	desc = oe_col4.30.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v160_ned_voc_harbor.dds"

	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }

	immediate = {
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_col4_valid_ow_staple_loc = yes }
			save_scope_as = ce_staple_loc
		}
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_col4_valid_ow_cashcrop_loc = yes }
			save_scope_as = ce_cash_loc
		}
	}

	# Option A: Potato & Maize Staple Revolution
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.30.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.30.a.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:ce_staple_loc }
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:ce_staple_loc = {
						OR = {
							climate = continental
							climate = oceanic
						}
					}
				}
				scope:ce_staple_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:potato }
			}
			else = {
				scope:ce_staple_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:maize }
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_ce_staple_boom_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
	}

	# Option B: Tobacco & Cocoa Cash-Crop Charter
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.30.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.30.b.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:ce_cash_loc }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:ce_cash_loc = { climate = tropical } }
				scope:ce_cash_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:cocoa }
			}
			else = {
				scope:ce_cash_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:tobacco }
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_ce_cashcrop_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
	}
}

oe_col4.31 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	title = oe_col4.31.t
	desc = oe_col4.31.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v160_ned_voc_harbor.dds"

	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }

	immediate = {
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_col4_valid_nw_ranch_loc = yes }
			save_scope_as = ce_ranch_loc
		}
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_col4_valid_nw_plantation_loc = yes }
			save_scope_as = ce_plant_loc
		}
	}

	# Option A: Eurasian Horses & Cattle Ranching
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.31.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.31.a.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 55 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:ce_ranch_loc }
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:ce_ranch_loc = {
						OR = {
							climate = hot_semi_arid
							climate = cold_semi_arid
							climate = continental
						}
					}
				}
				scope:ce_ranch_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:horses }
			}
			else = {
				scope:ce_ranch_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:livestock }
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_ce_ranching_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
	}

	# Option B: Sugar, Coffee & Wheat Estates
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.31.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.31.b.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 45 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:ce_plant_loc }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:ce_plant_loc = { climate = tropical } }
				scope:ce_plant_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:sugar }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:ce_plant_loc = { climate = subtropical } }
				scope:ce_plant_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:coffee }
			}
			else = {
				scope:ce_plant_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:wheat }
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_ce_plantation_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
	}
}

# 201: Colonial Charter Tax & Trade Concession (Overlord balances tariffs vs liberty desire)
oe_col4.201 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = neutral
	title = oe_col4.201.t
	desc = oe_col4.201.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v160_ned_voc_harbor.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		any_subject = { oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_col4_evol_ev_cd value = 1 days = 90 }
		ordered_subject = {
			limit = { oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes }
			order_by = total_population
			max = 1
			save_scope_as = focus_colony
		}
	}

	# Option A: Enforce Mercantile Navigation Tariffs
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.201.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.201.a.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 35
			modifier = {
				factor = 2.0
				trigger = { gold < 150 }
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0.4
				trigger = {
					any_subject = {
						oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
						liberty_desire >= 50
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_gold = 90
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_mercantile_tariffs_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		every_subject = {
			limit = { oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes }
			add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_plus
		}
	}

	# Option B: Grant Free-Port Trade Concessions
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.201.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.201.b.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 40
			modifier = {
				factor = 2.2
				trigger = {
					any_subject = {
						oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
						liberty_desire >= 45
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_charter_concession_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		every_subject = {
			limit = { oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes }
			add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus
		}
	}

	# Option C: Appoint an Adult Colonial Customs Commissioner for Joint Reform
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.201.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.201.c.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 25
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.6
				trigger = { gold >= 200 }
			}
		}
		add_gold = -40
		create_character = {
			age = 36
			adm = { 66 84 }
			dip = { 70 88 }
			mil = { 38 56 }
			estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
			culture = root.culture
			religion = root.religion
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_joint_customs_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:focus_colony }
			scope:focus_colony = { add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_weak_minus }
		}
	}
}

# 202: Arbitrate Colonial Viceroyalty Borders
oe_col4.202 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	title = oe_col4.202.t
	desc = oe_col4.202.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_nav2_treasure_fleet.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		any_subject = { oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_col4_evol_ev_cd value = 1 days = 90 }
		ordered_subject = {
			limit = { oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes }
			order_by = total_population
			max = 1
			save_scope_as = focus_colony
		}
	}

	# Option A: Confirm Settler Frontier Charters & Survey Roads
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.202.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.202.a.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 45
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.8
				trigger = {
					any_subject = {
						oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
						liberty_desire >= 40
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_frontier_charter_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:focus_colony }
			scope:focus_colony = {
				add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus
				capital ?= {
					if = {
						limit = { has_owner = yes owner ?= scope:focus_colony }
						change_development = 0.35
						change_prosperity = 0.06
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Option B: Draw a Strict Crown Proclamation Line
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.202.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.202.b.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 30
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.7
				trigger = { stability < 30 }
			}
		}
		add_prestige = 6
		add_stability = 3
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_proclamation_line_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:focus_colony }
			scope:focus_colony = { add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_weak_plus }
		}
	}

	# Option C: Dispatch an Experienced Adult Viceregal Boundary Governor
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.202.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.202.c.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 25
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.5
				trigger = { gold >= 220 }
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			age = 40
			adm = { 64 82 }
			dip = { 68 86 }
			mil = { 50 68 }
			estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
			culture = root.culture
			religion = root.religion
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:focus_colony }
			scope:focus_colony = {
				add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_col4_viceroy_grant_mod
					years = 10
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# 203: Grant Colonial Self-Government Charter (Age 5/6 peaceful dominion evolution)
oe_col4.203 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	title = oe_col4.203.t
	desc = oe_col4.203.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v185_grand_peace_treaty_harbor.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }

	}

		set_variable = { name = oe_col4_evol_ev_cd value = 1 days = 90 }
		ordered_subject = {
			limit = { oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes }
			order_by = total_population
			max = 1
			save_scope_as = focus_colony
		}
	}

	# Option A: Charter Autonomous Overseas Dominions
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.203.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.203.a.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 45
			modifier = {
				factor = 2.2
				trigger = {
					any_subject = {
						oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
						liberty_desire >= 50
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_imperial_federation_mod
			years = 20
			mode = replace
		}
		every_subject = {
			limit = { oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes }
			add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_severe_minus
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_col4_dominion_charter_mod
				years = 20
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}

	# Option B: Establish a Federated Colonial Parliament with an Adult Governor-General

		name = oe_col4.203.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.203.b.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 35
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.6
				trigger = { stability >= 35 }
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			age = 42
			adm = { 68 86 }
			dip = { 72 90 }
			mil = { 46 64 }
			estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
			culture = root.culture
			religion = root.religion
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_federated_council_mod
			years = 15
			mode = replace
		}
		every_subject = {
			limit = { oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes }
			add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus
		}
	}

	# Option C: Uphold Crown Prerogative with Limited Local Assemblies
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.203.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.203.c.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 20
			modifier = {
				factor = 0.4
				trigger = {

					}

# 204: The Colonial Congress of Independence (Colony Side)
oe_col4.204 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = neutral
	title = oe_col4.204.t
	desc = oe_col4.204.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v165_colonial_liberty.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
		exists = overlord
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_col4_evol_ev_cd value = 1 days = 90 }
		save_scope_as = rebel_colony
		if = {
			limit = { exists = overlord }
			overlord = { save_scope_as = former_overlord }
		}
	}

	# Option A: Proclaim Full Sovereignty & Dispatch the Declaration to the Crown
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.204.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.204.a.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 50
			modifier = {
				factor = 2.0
				trigger = { liberty_desire >= 75 }
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.6
				trigger = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions } }
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			age = 38
			trait_category = general
			adm = { 62 80 }
			dip = { 66 84 }
			mil = { 70 88 }
			estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
			culture = root.culture
			religion = root.religion
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_patriot_fervor_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:former_overlord }
			scope:former_overlord = {
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_col4.205 days = 7 }
			}
		}
	}

	# Option B: Dispatch an Olive Branch Petition Seeking Peaceful Emancipation or Dominion Status
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.204.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.204.b.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 35
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.8
				trigger = { liberty_desire < 75 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_col4_olive_branch value = 1 days = 60 }
		create_character = {
			age = 44
			adm = { 68 86 }
			dip = { 74 92 }
			mil = { 42 60 }
			estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
			culture = root.culture
			religion = root.religion
		}
		add_prestige = 5
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:former_overlord }
			scope:former_overlord = {
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_col4.205 days = 7 }
			}
		}
	}

	# Option C: Pause the Congress to Stockpile Militia Arms & Funds
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.204.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.204.c.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 15
			modifier = {
				factor = 2.0
				trigger = { gold < 80 }
			}
		}
		add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_plus
		add_gold = 60
		add_stability = 3
		set_variable = { name = oe_col4_indep_dec_cd value = 1 days = 730 }
	}
}

# 205: Colonial Independence Crisis: The Overseas Declaration (Overlord Side)
oe_col4.205 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = negative
	title = oe_col4.205.t
	desc = oe_col4.205.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v165_colonial_liberty.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		exists = scope:rebel_colony
		scope:rebel_colony = { is_subject_of = root }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_col4_evol_ev_cd value = 1 days = 90 }
		save_scope_as = former_overlord
	}

	# Option A: Grant Peaceful Emancipation & Commercial Amity
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.205.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.205.a.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 30
			modifier = {
				factor = 2.5
				trigger = {
					OR = {
						at_war = yes
						war_exhaustion >= 4
					}
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.8
				trigger = { scope:rebel_colony = { has_variable = oe_col4_olive_branch } }
			}
		}
		cancel_subject = scope:rebel_colony
		add_truce_with = {
			target = scope:rebel_colony
			years = 10
			mutual = yes
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_peaceful_emancipation_mod
			years = 15
			mode = replace
		}
		scope:rebel_colony = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_col4_named }
				remove_variable = oe_col4_named
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_col4.206 days = 5 }
		}
	}

	# Option B: Crush the Rebellion — War of Colonial Independence!
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.205.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.205.b.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 45
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.6
				trigger = {
					at_war = no
					war_exhaustion < 2
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0.4
				trigger = { war_exhaustion >= 5 }
			}
		}
		add_prestige = 8
		add_stability = -3
		scope:rebel_colony = {
			declare_war_with_cb = {
				target = root
				type = casus_belli:cb_independence_war
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_col4.206 days = 10 }
		}
	}

	# Option C: Offer an Emergency Home-Rule Compromise
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.205.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.205.c.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 25
			modifier = {
				factor = 2.2
				trigger = {
					gold >= 150
					scope:rebel_colony = { has_variable = oe_col4_olive_branch }
				}
			}
		}
		add_gold = -100
		add_prestige = -6
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_charter_concession_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		scope:rebel_colony = {
			add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_severe_minus
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_col4_dominion_charter_mod
				years = 15
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
}

# 206: Dawn of New World Sovereignty & Patriot Awakening (Colony / Newly Emancipated State)
oe_col4.206 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	title = oe_col4.206.t
	desc = oe_col4.206.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v185_grand_peace_treaty_harbor.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
		exists = capital
		capital = { oe_col4_is_colonial_frontier_loc = yes }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_col4_evol_ev_cd value = 1 days = 90 }
	}

	# Option A: Draft a Sovereign Constitutional Charter
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.206.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.206.a.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 40
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.8
				trigger = { at_war = no }
			}
		}
		add_prestige = 10
		create_character = {
			age = 35
			adm = { 68 86 }
			dip = { 68 86 }
			mil = { 56 74 }
			estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
			culture = root.culture
			religion = root.religion
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_sovereign_charter_mod
			years = 15
			mode = replace
		}
	}

	# Option B: Mobilize the Continental Militia & Frontier Regiments
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.206.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.206.b.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 35
			modifier = {
				factor = 2.4
				trigger = { at_war = yes }
			}
		}
		add_stability = 3
		create_character = {
			age = 33
			trait_category = general
			adm = { 50 68 }
			dip = { 52 70 }
			mil = { 72 90 }
			estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
			culture = root.culture
			religion = root.religion
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_patriot_fervor_mod
			years = 15
			mode = replace
		}
	}

	# Option C: Forge Transatlantic Commercial & Diplomatic Treaties
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.206.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.206.c.tt
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 25
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.7
				trigger = { gold < 150 }
			}
		}
		add_gold = 85
		add_prestige = 6
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_atlantic_amity_mod
			years = 15
			mode = replace
		}
	}
}
